name: jira-bitbucket
description: Bitbucket review queue and your open PRs in a pane; the current branch's PR, CI and Jira issue in a bar above the prompt

bkt.title: bkt executable
bkt.description: Path or name of the bkt CLI used for Bitbucket Data Center REST calls.

jiraServer.title: Jira MCP server
jiraServer.description: Name of the connected MCP server that has the jira_search tool (mcp-atlassian).

jiraUrl.title: Jira URL
jiraUrl.description: Base URL of Jira for issue links, e.g. https://jira.example.com. Leave empty to show issue keys without links.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane and status line poll Bitbucket and Jira.

reviewLimit.title: Review queue size
reviewLimit.description: How many PRs awaiting your review the pane lists (newest first).

openOnStart.title: Open pane on session start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it is otherwise opened with /jb).
